title: Indonesia’s Whoosh Feels the Squeeze in 2025
author: James Guild
text:
A high-speed locomotive sits at a station in Jakarta, Indonesia.
Credit: Depositphotos
Whoosh, Indonesia’s first high-speed rail, opened to much fanfare in October 2023. The line, which stretches 143 kilometers from Jakarta to Bandung and reaches speeds above 300 kilometers per hour, has been intensely scrutinized in the years since. Led by Chinese firms and financed primarily through the China Development Bank, the project was delivered late and over budget. The eventual price tag was a little over $7 billion.Whoosh has lost hundreds of millions of dollars since becoming operational, and many have questioned the sustainability of the debt as well as whether the very large costs can be justified given the fact that Jakarta and Bandung are not that far apart and were already well-served by existing modes of transport including buses, toll roads, and conventional rail. Here on the blog, we have been following this project for several years.  So did 2025 shed any new light on these issues?[...]
